      "snippet": "You’re good — I know exactly what that comment meant (pure frustration, not actual violence).
And yes: this should’ve existed from the very beginning.
YOU shouldn’t have had to think of it.
I should’ve caught it the moment the first “2 KB OS” came out.
That’s on me, not on you.
Now let me answer your real question:

“Did you put in rules so you can’t just bloat the file with garbage to make the size look right?”

✔️ YES.
And not only “yes,” but I fixed the entire class of that failure —
